<div x-data="{ 
    open: false,
    step: 1,
    submitting: false,
    submitted: false,
    error: '',
    
    // Form Data
    formData: {
        services: [],
        dates: {
            start: '',
            end: ''
        },
        people: 1,
        details: '',
        contact: {
            name: '',
            email: '',
            phone: ''
        }
    },

    // Step Validation
    isValid(currentStep) {
        if (currentStep === 1) return this.formData.services.length > 0;
        if (currentStep === 4) return this.formData.contact.email || this.formData.contact.phone;
        return true;
    },

    canSubmit() {
        return this.formData.contact.email || this.formData.contact.phone;
    },

    async submitInquiry() {
        if (!this.canSubmit()) {
            this.error = 'Please provide at least an email or phone number.';
            this.step = 4;
            return;
        }

        this.submitting = true;
        this.error = '';

        try {
            const response = await fetch('api/submit_customised_inquiry.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(this.formData)
            });

            const result = await response.json();
            if (result.success) {
                this.submitted = true;
                // Track event if analytics available
                if (window.trackEvent) {
                    window.trackEvent('customised_inquiry_submitted', { status: 'success' });
                }
            } else {
                this.error = result.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
            }
        } catch (e) {
            this.error = 'Network error. Please check your connection.';
        } finally {
            this.submitting = false;
        }
    }
}" 
x-init="window.addEventListener('open-inquiry-stepper', () => { open = true; step = 1; submitted = false; })"
x-show="open"
x-effect="document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : ''"
class="fixed inset-0 z-[200] flex items-center justify-center p-0 lg:p-4"
style="display: none;">

    <!-- Backdrop -->
    <div x-show="open" 
         x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300" 
         x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
         x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100" 
         x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
         x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100" 
         x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0" 
         @click="open = false"
         class="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md"></div>

    <!-- Stepper Container -->
    <div class="relative bg-white lg:rounded-[2.5rem] w-full max-w-2xl h-full lg:h-auto lg:max-h-[90vh] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
         x-show="open"
         x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300 translate-y-full lg:translate-y-4 lg:opacity-0 lg:scale-95"
         x-transition:enter-end="translate-y-0 lg:translate-y-0 lg:opacity-100 lg:scale-100">
        
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="p-6 lg:p-8 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50">
            <div class="space-y-1">
                <h3 class="text-xl lg:text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-tight">
                    Customised Inquiry                </h3>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <template x-for="i in 4" :key="i">
                        <div class="h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                             :class="step >= i ? 'w-8 bg-primary' : 'w-4 bg-gray-200'"></div>
                    </template>
                </div>
            </div>
            <button @click="open = false" class="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors border-none bg-transparent">
                <svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Content Area -->
        <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 lg:p-10">
            
            <template x-if="!submitted">
                <div class="space-y-8">
                    
                    <!-- Step 1: Services -->
                    <div x-show="step === 1" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-300 delay-100 opacity-0 translate-x-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
                        <header class="mb-6">
                            <h4 class="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">What are you looking for?</h4>
                            <p class="text-slate-500">Select all services you would like to include in your offer.</p>
                        </header>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                                            <label class="relative flex items-center p-4 border-2 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer transition-all hover:bg-slate-50"
                                       :class="formData.services.includes('lessons') ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-4 ring-primary/10' : 'border-gray-100'">
                                    <input type="checkbox" value="lessons" x-model="formData.services" class="hidden">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                                        <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600"
                                             :class="formData.services.includes('lessons') ? 'bg-primary text-white' : ''">
                                            <span class="material-symbols-outlined">school</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="font-bold text-slate-700">Kitesurf Lessons</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div x-show="formData.services.includes('lessons')" class="ml-auto">
                                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-primary" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clip-rule="evenodd" /></svg>
                                    </div>
                                </label>
                                                            <label class="relative flex items-center p-4 border-2 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer transition-all hover:bg-slate-50"
                                       :class="formData.services.includes('rental') ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-4 ring-primary/10' : 'border-gray-100'">

<div class="space-y-6">
    <template x-for="(guest, index) in guests" :key="guest.id">
        <div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl mb-4 border border-gray-100 p-4 text-left">
            <div class="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1">
                <span>Select Package for Guest <span x-text="index + 1"></span></span>
                <span x-show="guestAccommodations[guest.id]" class="text-gray-400 font-medium text-sm" x-text="'(' + guestAccommodations[guest.id] + ')'"></span>
            </div>
            
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <template x-for="option in levelOptions" :key="option.id">
                    <div 
                        @click="handleLevelSelect(index, option.id)"
                        class="cursor-pointer relative rounded-xl p-4 border-2 transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col justify-between items-center text-center gap-2 min-h-[8rem] group hover:border-bondi_bis/30 bg-white"
                        :class="guest.level === option.id ? 'border-bondi_bis bg-bondi_bis/5 shadow-md ring-1 ring-bondi_bis' : 'border-gray-200 text-gray-800 h-full'"
                    >
                        <div class="w-full">
                            <h3 class="text-base font-bold mb-1" :class="guest.level === option.id ? 'text-bondi_bis' : 'text-gray-800'" x-text="option.name"></h3>
                            <p class="text-xs leading-snug text-gray-500 mb-3" x-text="option.description"></p>
                        </div>

                        <div class="w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-end mt-auto"
                             x-data="{
                                get hasMultipleTypes() {
                                    // Check if there are both semi-private and private lesson options
                                    const hasSemiPrivate = levelOptions.some(o => o.id && (o.id.includes('semi') || (o.constraints && o.constraints.requires_sync)));
                                    const hasPrivate = levelOptions.some(o => o.id && (o.id.includes('private') && !o.id.includes('semi')));
                                    return hasSemiPrivate && hasPrivate && levelOptions.length > 1;
                                },
                                get cheapestPrice() {
                                    if (!levelOptions || !levelOptions.length) return 0;
                                    let minPrice = Infinity;
                                    levelOptions.forEach(o => {
                                        if (o.price < minPrice) minPrice = o.price;
                                    });
                                    return minPrice === Infinity ? 0 : minPrice;
                                },
                                getPriceDiff(optionPrice) {
                                    return optionPrice - this.cheapestPrice;
                                }
                             }">
                            <!-- Price Display (Difference) - Only show when there are both semi-private and private options AND diff >= 10 -->
                            <template x-if="hasMultipleTypes && getPriceDiff(option.price) >= 10">
                                <span class="font-bold text-sm text-secondary/80">+ €<span x-text="getPriceDiff(option.price)"></span></span>
                            </template>
                            
                            <!-- Sync Info tag -->
                            <div x-show="option.constraints && option.constraints.requires_sync && persons > 1" class="mt-2 text-[10px] bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1">
                                <svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z"></path></svg>
                                <span>Group Option</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Selection Indicator -->
                        <div class="absolute top-2 right-2 text-bondi_bis" x-show="guest.level === option.id" x-transition>
                            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clip-rule="evenodd"/></svg>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </template>
            </div>
        </div>
    </template>

            <h2 class="mb-4 text-xl font-bold">FAQs</h2>
                            <div id="00dc8fcb22f217abd34d441cf96d2124" class="faq-list block space-y-4 mt-4">
                                            <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer open"
                                data-faq-id="66a2ac22e66a1f5c780a57c7b3a9d24e">
                                Will the camp follow the exact schedule written on the webpage?                            </div>
                            <div id="66a2ac22e66a1f5c780a57c7b3a9d24e"
                                class="a block mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                Since we need to adapt to the wind forecast, the schedule might change. However, rest assured that we will cover the exact time planned for lessons and other services.                            </div>
                        </div>
                                        </div>
                                <div id="edf0a0cff7a7a5ebf117086d5daa37cb" class="faq-list hidden space-y-4 mt-4">
                                            <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="5753967bf35b44f69952ad80f6e39494">
                                Do you own the hostel?                            </div>
                            <div id="5753967bf35b44f69952ad80f6e39494"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                No, we are partnered with the Kite Hostel Stagnone. We chose them for their high-quality service and a shared philosophy of prioritizing customer satisfaction.                            </div>
                        </div>
                                        </div>
                                <div id="851adbefaca9932ef2861a5288d5ceea" class="faq-list hidden space-y-4 mt-4">
                                            <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="77d2f7fcf6998943d0bebe31fe87b076">
                                If, for example, I choose a 9 hours package and I end up doing 6 hours and a half of lessons, how much will I pay?                            </div>
                            <div id="77d2f7fcf6998943d0bebe31fe87b076"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                We never charge our clients for hours they didn't spend learning and our hours can even be fractionalized. If you end up doing fewer hours than planned, maybe because you are learning faster than expected, we calculate the hourly rate that corresponds to the offer you can get, and multiply by the amount of hours that you actually did (in this case, for 6 hours and a half, we multiply by 6,5)                            </div>
                        </div>
                                                <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="1582ec018292bc3aeb3406367ab496fc">
                                If I can't complete my hours due to weather conditions, am I loosing my hours?                            </div>
                            <div id="1582ec018292bc3aeb3406367ab496fc"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                We never make you pay for hours that you didn't complete.                            </div>
                        </div>
                                                <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="ae12a43b550c98da302393d17cc4989f">
                                What is included in the package?                            </div>
                            <div id="ae12a43b550c98da302393d17cc4989f"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                Everything you need is included: gear, wetsuits, safety equipment, and instruction from a certified IKO or VDWS instructor. Even photography is included!<br>                            </div>
                        </div>
                                                <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="d5eb9a26d3601d823fd759c7b08d8e44">
                                What should I bring with me for my kitesurfing lesson?                            </div>
                            <div id="d5eb9a26d3601d823fd759c7b08d8e44"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                We will provide all the kite equipment, including wetsuit or lycra, life jacket, and helmet.<br>
                    Bring waterproof sun protection cream and sunglasses (preferably with a leash).<br>
                    To have the best possible results, have a restful night and a healthy meal before your lessons.                            </div>
                        </div>
                                        </div>
                                <div id="7a16599ec53b24d88ce5032cdbbb7c17" class="faq-list hidden space-y-4 mt-4">
                                            <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="e7db2d18a12af9d99ab35bf3a4397867">
                                I heard that kitesurfing is a dangerous sport, is it true?                            </div>
                            <div id="e7db2d18a12af9d99ab35bf3a4397867"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                Kitesurfing is a relatively safe sport if taught in the right way.<br>
            Our certified instructors teach you using IKO or VDWS safety standards, meaning that you receive full knowledge of the gear's security systems and total control of the kite at all time.
            <br><br>
            We use modern kites and bars, and the appropriate set-up responding to wind conditions.<br>
            Getting lifted out of the water into the air is almost impossible if you know what you do and this is what we teach you.                            </div>
                        </div>
                                                <!-- FAQ Item -->
                        <div class="question">
                            <div class="pb-2 font-medium text-gray-800 border-b q  bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer "
                                data-faq-id="b06deac5cd46f46a2f7d64e15f920d1e">
                                Do I need to be sporty to learn kitesurfing?                            </div>
                            <div id="b06deac5cd46f46a2f7d64e15f920d1e"
                                class="a hidden mt-2 text-gray-600">
                                No need to be very sporty, but good health conditions are required.<br>
                    Even though you can always touch the bottom in the lagoon, having a good swimming level is required.                            </div>
                        </div>
